name: real-time-desktop-agent
description: Realtime Windows desktop complement for AI agents with capture, vision, mouse, keyboard, UIA, and safe dry-run actions.

interface.shortDescription: Realtime desktop capture and safe automation tools for AI agents.
interface.longDescription: Expose RTDA as a local MCP-backed plugin for ChatGPT and Codex. The plugin provides 13 core tools including monitor discovery, capture diagnostics, UI Automation inspection, goal planning, multi-modal desktop observation, UI element search, risk classification, direct desktop actions (mouse/keyboard), and autonomous multi-step task execution.
defaultPrompt: Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to observe current desktop state and active window.
Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to run an autonomous multi-step task.
Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to inspect UIA elements and find UI controls.
Use Real-Time Desktop Agent to run a capture diagnostic.
